title: BillingBalanceTransferRequest
description: billing.balance-transfer-request@1: body of POST /api/me/balance/transfers (D12). Moves amount_nano_usd from the signed-in person's Balance to a project they administer, into that project's Balance. Money is positive integer nano-USD as a decimal string (D1), never a float; the transfer is refused when the Balance or the person's project role is short. idempotency_key makes the transfer exactly once: a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer and moves nothing.

to_project_id.description: The project whose Balance receives the money; the person must administer it.

amount_nano_usd.description: A positive integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD) as a decimal string (D1), never a float.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per mutation. A replay with the same key and body returns the first answer and changes nothing.
